owner_authorization.quote: 按照你的这些建议全部去做吧。
owner_authorization.scope: Implement the proposed fixed-scale MA-box review and QA sequence; protocol/sample review remains required before full relabeling or training.

question: Can a fixed-scale, MA-derived box protocol eliminate candle-high/low supervision while keeping the visual target large and consistently defined enough for a later YOLO Gold dataset?
single_variable_statement: This is a non-training bundled protocol-design review explicitly authorized by the Owner: fixed W20 replaces W14-22, horizontal candidates become data-derived L4/L5/L6/L7 MA segments, and vertical candidates compare exact-plus-padding against 16/24/32 model-pixel minimum heights. No performance or economic claim is made.

review_selection.ordering: Stable SHA256 ordering within each direction/split/time bin, preferring unused symbols before deterministic fill.

negative_visual_rows.selection: Twelve deterministic L5-density quantiles per kind.

render_contract.window_end_assignment: Stable SHA256 display-only assignment; it cannot alter box source bars.
render_contract.horizontal_score: For each length independently, minimize (max of all six MA values across the segment - min) / mean close; exact ties choose the later end.
render_contract.vertical_source: Only SMA/EMA 20/60/120 values inside the selected segment; candle open/high/low/close never set y bounds.
render_contract.minimum_height_expansion: Symmetric around the MA-envelope center, preserving all six MA points.
render_contract.review_horizontal_control: L4/L5/L6/L7 all use minimum 24 model pixels.
render_contract.review_vertical_control: L5 compares exact-plus-padding, 16, 24 and 32 model pixels.

negative_audit.question: How much does L5 MA-density overlap between weak positives, hard no-launch negatives and easy no-launch negatives under the same W20 renderer?
negative_audit.interpretation_guard: A dense knot in a negative does not automatically become a positive; it proves that the eventual class must include launch/release semantics rather than density alone.

gates.next_gate: Owner reviews all 50 protocol samples and confirms one global horizontal/vertical rule; protocol confirmation still does not silently confirm all 9,938 samples.
